coverage_note: Baltimore County independent district comparison, 2024–25: exact NCES LEA 2400120 / MD-03 / MSDE 03. All 137 audited grade-school profiles are searchable with their own individual Early Attendance income; 126 Math, 137 ELA and 126 independently fitted Combined results use separate fixed populations. Eleven original Math <= 5.0 masks retain ELA and remain unavailable for Math/Combined. Meadowood and Crossroads alternatives retain ELA only. Watershed Public Charter 03-0219 / NCES 240012001753 remains outside these models because original offered-grade flags are adjusted. Native regular MCAP All Grades All Students Levels 3/4 includes accelerated courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver; alternate DLM stays separate. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable. Admissions, provider roles, programs, coordinates and boundaries remain unaudited; one year only.

methodology.summary: Baltimore County independent regular MCAP grade-school district models with individual Early Attendance income; valid-score count scope and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Baltimore County independent 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school district models: exact operational NCES LEA 2400120 / CCD native MD-03 / MSDE 03 identities. All 137 native E/M/EM profiles with positive September grades 3–8 and no high-grade row remain searchable. Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades Levels 3/4 published rates support 126 Math, 137 ELA and 126 independently fitted Combined results; 11 Math masks retain ELA. Precise same-year individual Early Attendance ratios use their own denominators. Accelerated Math courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver remain in native totals; DLM stays separate. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Three separate unweighted OLS fits reproduce all 389 audited results and explicit centered deleted fits. Combined independently fits the paired 126 original Math/ELA rate means with its own scale and studentization. ELA has 137 members, so full subject coefficients, scores and scales cannot be averaged. Filters never refit models; associations do not establish causal effectiveness or overall quality.

Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades published proficiency uses MCAP Levels 3 and 4 under the four-level standards introduced in 2021–22. Native totals include Algebra 1, Geometry and Algebra 2 where present and the applicable 2024–25 through 2027–28 grade 6–7 course waiver. Grade-level percentages and course components never replace the published total; alternate DLM remains separate.

2024–25 individual Economically Disadvantaged Cnt divided by the same school’s own Early Attendance Total Student Cnt. Use the exact whole-school All row when native bands overlap, or the single complete school band; reconcile the published one-decimal percentage without replacing the precise count ratio. This benefits/status measure includes specified assistance/direct-certification categories and is not full household-income FRPL or universal meal receipt; identification coverage is unknown. Never replace with FARMS, September/CCD enrollment, participation, tested-subgroup income or another year. The collection as-of date is unspecified; original masks and missingness remain unavailable.

September district enrollment 110,024 agrees with CCD district and operational-school totals. Known native school September totals sum to 110,015, leaving 9 unassigned. Known Early Attendance school denominators 110,357 differ from district 110,382 by 25, with eight outside-scope denominators unavailable. These differences do not establish their causes, repair missing values or certify a tested population.

Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Native administrative Tested Count, Early Attendance income denominators, September/CCD enrollment, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute for valid-score denominators. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals are unavailable. Studentization uses every explicit deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom; it provides no enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Never reconstruct masked rates or valid-score counts.

All 389 full/deleted designs retain rank two and finite positive scales. Largest deleted prediction changes over observed incomes: Math 1.315010; ELA 1.047119; Combined 0.938110 percentage points. Influence and leverage flags are descriptive, never exclusions or prediction clamps. No eligible charter remains after authoritative offered-grade selection; charter and alternative labels themselves never determine eligibility.

The complete immutable source retains 4,536 needed original records and 75,620 typed cells, full headers and primary definitions, plus exact omitted-row inventories and typed-cell digests within whole pinned archives. Compact pointers preserve original row, member, worksheet, field and column references. Source and numerical audit approvals remain false; only this exact independently reviewed point contract is approved.

All 178 native identities match exact same-year CCD NCES records; two additional CCD-only closed records stay outside. High, mixed, primary, unknown and adjusted configurations remain held. Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles, coordinates and boundaries are unknown. One year only. Incompatible state thresholds and income definitions cannot create a common national ranking.
